name: broad_corporate_news
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Thursday September 24, 2026. Scope: Corporate news flow.

Window: Wednesday September 23, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Thursday September 24, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
- Biggest US movers (market cap >= $2B) in the session, after-hours, and pre-market, with the catalyst for each (CNBC / MarketWatch / Barron's / Reuters 'stocks making the biggest moves').
- Earnings after the close or pre-market: EPS and revenue actual vs consensus, guidance old → new.
- Notable analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- M&A (terms, value), contracts with $ size, FDA decisions, SEC filings (8-K, 13D, S-1, offerings), buybacks, executive changes, index adds/deletes, activist stakes.
- Sector threads: AI capex / hyperscaler spend, semis and memory pricing, AI networking and optics, data-center power, software/SaaS; supply-chain reports (Nikkei, DigiTimes, TrendForce).

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **MCD** — Consumer / Restaurants
- CEO Chris Kempczinski said at McDonald’s investor day on September 23 that high inflation and flat traffic were expected to weigh on the restaurant industry; U.S. same-store sales growth in the latest quarter was 0.8%, with domestic traffic down, and shares fell more than 5% during the session. (CNBC)
- McDonald’s shares reached their lowest level since 2022 during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **CBRL** — Consumer / Restaurants
- Cracker Barrel reported fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted EPS of **$0.99**, versus **$0.74** a year earlier, and revenue of **$849.3 million**, versus a FactSet consensus estimate of **$834.6 million**. (CNBC)
- Shares rose approximately **5%** during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **WOR** — Specialty Materials & Industrial
- Worthington Enterprises reported fiscal first-quarter adjusted EPS and revenue above Street estimates, and CEO Joseph Hayek cited demand for engineered ASME tanks used in data-center liquid-cooling systems. (CNBC)
- Shares rose approximately **4%** intraday and approximately **16%** pre-market on September 24. (CNBC)

## **AHG** — Software & SaaS / Healthcare
- Astrana Health disclosed in a regulatory filing that private and confidential information had been accessed without authorization; the company described the incident as a “material” data breach and said its investigation was ongoing. (CNBC)
- Shares fell approximately **6%** during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **RCL** — Consumer / Travel
- Royal Caribbean announced an agreement to acquire a **50% stake** in the parent company of Sandals and Beaches Resorts for **$3 billion**; the transaction was expected to close in early 2027 and add to earnings in 2027. (CNBC)
- Shares declined nearly **3%** and reached a 52-week low during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **BABA** — Internet & Platforms
- Alibaba’s U.S.-listed shares declined approximately **4%** on September 23 after a four-session advance. (CNBC)
- Investing.com reported a September 23 decline of approximately **4.5%** for Alibaba. (Investing.com)

## **PAYX** — Software & SaaS
- Paychex reported first-quarter adjusted EPS above estimates, while revenue of **$1.63 billion** was in line with the FactSet consensus estimate. (CNBC)
- Shares fell nearly **7%** during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **IONQ** — Quantum Computing
- IonQ said it had tested what it described as the industry’s first real-time quantum-error decoder. (CNBC)
- Shares rose approximately **5%** during the September 23 session and approximately **12%** pre-market on September 24. (CNBC)

## **CART** — Internet & Platforms
- Maplebear said customers on the Instacart grocery platform would be able to use Meta’s personal AI agent, Muse. (CNBC)
- Shares fell approximately **3%** during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **IMVT** — Biotechnology
- Immunovant reported disappointing proof-of-concept trial results for IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus. (CNBC)
- Shares fell approximately **9%** during the September 23 session. (CNBC)

## **VICR** — Power & Wide-Bandgap
- Vicor revised its third-quarter sequential revenue-growth outlook to **more than 20%**, from its prior projection of **nearly 10%**. (Yahoo Finance)
- Shares rose **19.9%** on September 23. (Yahoo Finance)

## **GRAIL** — Biotechnology / Diagnostics
- FDA advisers voted **7–2** that the benefits of Grail’s Galleri multi-cancer blood test outweighed its risks and voted **6–4** on whether the test was effective. (The Company Chronicle)
- Grail shares had risen **34%** before the advisory vote. (The Company Chronicle)

## **KNR** — Industrials / Construction Materials
- Activist investor Starboard built a stake in Knife River and pushed for a sale or higher margins. **[rumor]** (The Company Chronicle)

## **SMR / SWR** — Specialty Materials & Packaging
- Smurfit Westrock agreed to acquire CMPC’s Chilean box business for **$420 million**. (The Company Chronicle)

## **AMC** — Media & Entertainment / Credit
- AMC priced a refinancing consisting of **$2 billion** of first-lien notes at **8.875%** and an **$850 million** loan at **SOFR plus 4.5%**; the refinancing extended the 2029 debt wall to 2031 and later. (The Company Chronicle)

## **ALCOA / South32** — Specialty Materials
- Alcoa closed **$2.6 billion** of bonds carrying coupons of up to **6.875%** to fund the **$3.1 billion** cash portion of its acquisition of South32’s aluminum assets. (The Company Chronicle)

## **PTON** — Software & SaaS / Consumer
- Peloton was considering an approximately **$800 million** debut bond at about **8%**, compared with its existing term loan priced at SOFR plus 6%. **[rumor]** (The Company Chronicle)

## **NYSE / Blockchain.com** — Crypto / Market Infrastructure
- NYSE signed a nonbinding agreement with Blockchain.com to explore tokenized U.S. stocks for Blockchain.com’s approximately **44 million** accounts; the memorandum set no launch date. (The Company Chronicle)

## **MoonPay / North Capital** — Crypto / Financial Infrastructure
- MoonPay agreed to acquire broker-dealer and trading platform North Capital for more than **$60 million** in stock; North Capital had handled more than **$8.7 billion** of securities transactions. (The Company Chronicle)

## **OTC Link** — Financial Infrastructure / Regulation
- The SEC fined OTC Link **$575,000** over more than eight years of deficiencies involving systems-security compliance. (The Company Chronicle)

## **MPWR** — Semiconductors
- Monolithic Power Systems was the leading S&P 500 gainer on September 23, rising **8.1%**. (Trefis)

## **SNDK** — Memory & Interconnect
- SanDisk rose **6.8%** on September 23. (Trefis)

## **MU** — Memory & Interconnect
- Micron rose **5.0%** on September 23. (Trefis)

## **STX** — Memory & Interconnect
- Seagate Technology rose **4.8%** on September 23. (Trefis)

## **TER** — Test & Advanced Packaging
- Teradyne rose **4.5%** on September 23. (Trefis)

## **GEN** — Software & SaaS / Cybersecurity
- Gen Digital was the weakest S&P 500 performer listed for September 23, declining **6.4%**. (Trefis)

## **EXPE** — Internet & Platforms
- Expedia declined approximately **6.2%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **APP** — Software & SaaS
- AppLovin declined approximately **6.2%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **VOYG** — Communications & Networking
- Voyager Technologies declined approximately **13.3%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **RELY** — Software & SaaS
- Remitly Global declined approximately **7.0%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **VKTX** — Biotechnology
- Viking Therapeutics declined approximately **5.1%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **BFLY** — Medical Devices
- Butterfly Network declined approximately **5.2%** on September 23. (Investing.com)

## **ALKT** — Software & SaaS
- Alkami Technology declined approximately **18.8%** on September 23; its market capitalization was listed below the requested **$2 billion** threshold in the cited market-mover data. (Investing.com)

## **INNV** — Healthcare Services
- InnovAge Holding declined approximately **10.8%** on September 23; its market capitalization was listed below the requested **$2 billion** threshold in the cited market-mover data. (Investing.com)

## **September 24 Earnings Calendar** — Calendar
- Darden Restaurants was listed with an expected pre-market EPS of **$2.08** and revenue of **$3.2 billion**; actual results were not available in the gathered material. (Digrin)
- TD SYNNEX was listed with an expected pre-market EPS of **$4.75** and revenue of **$19.1 billion**; actual results were not available in the gathered material. (Digrin)
- Blackstone Mortgage Trust was listed with an expected pre-market EPS of **$0.27** and revenue of **$78.5 million**; actual results were not available in the gathered material. (Digrin)
- Endava was listed with an expected pre-market EPS of **$0.15** and revenue of **$243.6 million**; its market capitalization was listed at **$146.9 million**, below the requested **$2 billion** threshold. (Digrin)

## **SEC Filings** — Corporate Filings
- SEC filings dated September 23 included a report of **$425 million** in share buybacks through September 21 by an issuer identified in the filing index as Sun Communities. (Stock Titan)
- Meta COO Javier Olivan reported a sale of **1,575 shares** at **$680.27** per share under a trading plan. (Stock Titan)
- An H&S Investments filing disclosed plans for another sale of Broadcom shares following a **$120 million** share sale in June. (Stock Titan)
- A director-controlled firm reported the sale of **245,129 Bullish shares** under a trading plan over three days. (Stock Titan)
- Big Digital Energy disclosed a **$2.57 million** debt exchange that granted shares to the executive chairman’s firm. (Stock Titan)

## **IPO / SEC Statistics** — Macro / Calendar
- The SEC reported **208 IPOs** in the first half of 2026, with proceeds above **$137 billion**; **118** of the offerings were blank-check companies, and operating-company listings declined **21%**. (The Company Chronicle)
